objective: Develop and internally evaluate a human MDR1 matched-parental structural screening candidate using direct numeric net-efflux evidence.

development_dataset.source: Soskuti et al. 2024, Supplementary Table S1
development_dataset.primary_endpoint: conservative binary class derived from hMDR1 ER / Mock ER with approximate 95% interval entirely above or below net ER=2
development_dataset.sensitivity_endpoint: point class derived from hMDR1 ER / Mock ER at net ER=2 after source QC exclusions
development_dataset.continuous_endpoint: log2(hMDR1 ER / Mock ER) after source QC exclusions

posthoc_audit_correction.reason: Blank PU/unlabeled target_label values from the broad interface were incorrectly treated as comparable weak labels in overlap metadata.
posthoc_audit_correction.performance_result_effect: none; deterministic replay required and recorded

identity_and_leakage_rules.structure_standardization: ABCB1 screener v0.1 project standardizer; non-chiral Morgan fingerprints
identity_and_leakage_rules.grouping: Bemis-Murcko scaffold; acyclic structures get identity-specific groups
identity_and_leakage_rules.frozen_443_weak_label_data: may be scored diagnostically but may not be mixed into primary direct-evidence cross-validation
identity_and_leakage_rules.existing_20260803_external_benchmark: never used for tuning, model selection, applicability threshold revision, or performance claims
identity_and_leakage_rules.soskuti_2024_panel: permanent development material after this lock; never a future untouched validation set

outer_evaluation.prediction_aggregation: mean probability per entity across outer repeats
outer_evaluation.uncertainty: 2000 scaffold-cluster bootstrap replicates on entity-level aggregated outer predictions

inner_selection.selection_metric: MCC then balanced_accuracy then lower complexity
inner_selection.ridge_selection_metric: MAE then higher Spearman correlation then stronger regularization

model_selection_rule: Among learned classifiers, maximize scaffold-cluster-bootstrap median MCC, then balanced accuracy, then Brier; selection remains an internal-development choice.
claim_boundary: Internal single-source assay-aware development only. No validated universal ABCB1 substrate, intact-ADC, intracellular exposure, resistance, efficacy, or clinical claim.
future_go_gate: A new untouched source/temporal/prospective human ABCB1 matched-parental dataset must pass prelocked external gates before upgrading the candidate to a validated predictor.
